overall_reason: Inter Variable, Linear's own face across its product and site, sets every page role at tuned settings (display at leading 1.0 with -0.022em tracking, weight 510, hung opening quotes in the testimonials), and Berkeley Mono is held to figure captions, code and the product mock-ups.

score.reason: T-TYPE-SOURCE, T-LEADING, T-MEASURE, T-HEAD-TREATMENT and T-FIGURES pass; T-LABEL-TRANSFORM finds one tracked-caps mono label under the logo wall, and the 14 sizes the sweep counts come mostly from the product mock-ups.

findings.title: Small labels earn their caps
findings.where: logo wall caption, 1440 (tiles/1440-01.png, below the customer logos) and 375
findings.evidence: The type table lists "Powering the companies building the future" as a 12px uppercase label in Berkeley Mono, and as the only mono paragraph on the page. It is a full sentence, not a code or a figure. The other caps labels ("FIG 0.1" to "FIG 0.3", tiles/1440-02.png) are figure numbers and earn their setting.
findings.before: POWERING THE COMPANIES BUILDING THE FUTURE, 12px mono caps in grey
findings.after: The sentence in Inter at the 13 to 15px small step, sentence case
findings.why: A whole sentence in mono caps at 12px reads slower than the same words in sentence case, and the mono costume belongs to the figure captions.

strengths: Inter Variable is the brand's own face, set at intermediate weights (510, 590) rather than stock 500 or 600.
Display is tuned: h2 at 48 and 72px with leading 1.0 and -0.022em tracking; it steps to 24 to 38px at 375 with leading 1.1 to 1.33.
The testimonial quotes hang their opening marks outside the text edge and use curly quotes (tiles/1440-09.png).
One declared head signature: "A new species of product tool." in white running into a grey run-on (tiles/1440-01.png), used once.
Measure is short: a median of 39 characters a line at 1440, no paragraph over 75.
Berkeley Mono is held to figure captions, branch names and code in the product mock-ups.
The stylesheet sets tabular-nums and text-wrap: balance and pretty.
not_investigated: The product mock-ups (issue view, Slack thread, board, tiles/1440-00.png to 1440-03.png) imitate Linear's app and Slack; their 10 to 13px text, weight 300 chat text and three-dot runs ("disappeared...", "every time...") are product imagery, not the page's type system.
T-PUNCTUATION: 2 three-dot runs against 18 true ellipses and 4 straight double quotes, all inside the mock-ups; the page's own copy uses curly marks.
T-HEADLINE-FIT: the h1 runs 2 lines at 1440 and 4 at 375; the sweep's h1_words hit owns its length. "Intake / and integrations" breaks the same way at every width, so it reads as a set break.
Small text sizes and the 14-size count are the sweep's (text_floor, type_ladder).
